source.detail: Synthetic hand-assembled PostgreSQL EXPLAIN JSON used only to exercise relation-scan roots with direct no-scan subplan children. Not captured from a live server and not evidence of performance.

features: Seq Scan root with direct SubPlan child

expect.scenario: relation scan root with a differently typed no-scan child
expect.sql: SELECT * FROM orders AS o WHERE (SELECT 1) > 0 AND o.status = 'open';
expect.operation: change the direct child subplan role from InitPlan to SubPlan
expectedChanges: the scan root does not match across subplan role changes
